draft.emotion: a sense of settling down after the day, quiet and peaceful
notes: Spanish divides the end of the day differently from English: 'tarde' lasts until dusk or dinner time (around 8–9 p.m. in Spain), and 'noche' begins after dark, covering both English 'evening' and 'night'.
Note the common expressions 'por la noche' (at night / in the evening) and 'esta noche' (tonight).

senses.definition: The dark part of the day, from after sunset until sunrise, including the late evening.
